question: Atelectasis is a restrictive pathology of ventilation characterized by:

options.opa: The anomalous dilation of the bronchi.
options.opb: The abnormal expansion of the pleural space.
options.opd: The fibrosis of the pulmonary parenchyma.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Atelectasis -> impaired ventilation -> decreased oxygenation -> 95% CHAIN: Atelectasis -> collapse of alveoli -> reduced lung compliance -> 90% CHAIN: Atelectasis -> decreased surfactant production -> alveolar collapse -> 95%
enhanced_information: Atelectasis is a restrictive pathology of ventilation characterized by the collapse of the alveoli. This leads to reduced lung compliance and impaired ventilation, ultimately resulting in decreased oxygenation. The anomalous dilation of the bronchi, abnormal expansion of the pleural space, and fibrosis of the pulmonary parenchyma are not characteristic of atelectasis.
